annotations.title: Send an invoice reminder (preview, then confirm)

description: Email GetAccountED's standard branded payment reminder (with pay-online link and the invoice PDF) for one unpaid invoice to the customer's email on file. TWO STEPS: first call shows who it goes to + confirm_token; the email is only sent on the second call with confirm_token. Changes the user's real books — only after they have seen the preview and agreed. Needs the user's GetAccountED sign-in (they are asked to sign in the first time).

business_id.description: Accounting practices only: which client's books (an id from accounting_list_my_businesses). Leave out to use the books chosen at sign-in.

confirm_token.description: Second step only: the token from the preview

invoice_number.description: The invoice to remind the customer about (from accounting_list_invoices)

name: accounting_send_invoice_reminder
